definitions.gloss: feeling of fullness; sense of being full; satiety
definitions.explanation: The physical sensation of having eaten enough. Commonly discussed in the context of diet, health, and food.

examples.japanese: {満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得|え}られた→得る：02014_eru⟧。
⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{噛|か}んで→噛む：01205_kamu⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じ→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: If you chew your food well, you feel full more easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カロリー→カロリー：06109_karorii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This dish is low in calories but still filling.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{満腹|まんぷく}→満腹：06533_manpuku⟧ (full stomach) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense). Frequently used in health and diet contexts when discussing how foods affect appetite.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to feel full, to achieve satiety
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to sense fullness
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be filling
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: fullness lasts
- {満腹感|まんぷくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: not very filling

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{満腹|まんぷく}→満腹：06533_manpuku⟧: full (stomach) — the base word describing the state itself
- ⟦{空腹感|くうふくかん}→空腹感：20134_kuufukukan⟧: feeling of hunger — the opposite sensation
- ⟦{腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}→腹八分目：08318_harahachibunme⟧: eating until 80% full — a traditional health guideline
